finding: Sides intro is switched off: Play_Intro returns on its first line (TIBERIANDAWN/INIT.CPP:1775) and Choose_Side hard-codes GDI (TIBERIANDAWN/INTRO.CPP:85) or Allies (REDALERT/INTRO.CPP:76). First screen is the scenario briefing movie, then the map. Mission INI and TUTORIAL.INI are not in the repo, so the first fight and tutor text were not read.

First launch after install skips the title menu on 12 MB+ machines and selects New Game (TIBERIANDAWN/INIT.CPP:988-989); under 12 MB it plays the INTRO2 movie first (INIT.CPP:820-827). The first-run key is rewritten to No on read, not on completion (STARTUP.CPP:566-568, 583).

Tutor lines are a Red Alert trigger action that posts TutorialText[n] to the overlay after Rule.MessageDelay minutes (REDALERT/TACTION.CPP:372; default 0.6 min at REDALERT/RULES.CPP:166). Non-modal, event-keyed, no null check on the text.

Services appear one at a time in the sidebar: the sweep removes any item that cannot be built even in theory (TIBERIANDAWN/SIDEBAR.CPP:1984-1992); add-back code not read. Loss plays a lose movie then asks to replay the same scenario (SCENARIO.CPP:653-660).

Black Gate intro is five scenes (title, logo, guardian, desk, moongate); each scene is skippable and a break ends the whole chain (gamemgr/bggame.cc:440-445, 1259-1420). Desk scene is a hand-hits-PC beat, two caption art shapes and a 98-step scroll at 110 ms, clipped to 320x200 (bggame.cc:1265). Captions are art, not text.

Quotes menu item shows only after the Credits sequence is watched through (game.cc:656; bggame.cc:1966-1967 writes quotes.flg on completion). Endgame shows when endgame.flg exists (game.cc:657). The did_first_scene flag keeps the Avatar hidden until the usecode opening scene runs; skip_intro=yes sets it (gamewin.cc:2907-2918).

Character setup is name (16 chars max), sex and face pickers, four choice slots, run once before Journey Onwards (gamemgr/bggame.cc:1971-1998; game.cc:715-732). Start location, first quest, first fight and town are in INITGAME and usecode, not in the repo, so not read.
